text:
Together AI's data handling page has new zero data retention text as of Nov 23.
Before: "Prompt storage: On by default. Stores prompts and model responses for product..."
After: "Prompt storage: Off by default for new organizations. Stores prompts and..."
https://inference-index.vercel.app/changelog

entry.before:
Prompt storage: On by default. Stores prompts and model responses for product improvements. Turn it off to enable ZDR, which also turns off passthrough models.
Passthrough models: On by default. Allows your organization to use models that forward prompts and responses to third-party providers. Passthrough requires prompt storage, so you can’t turn this toggle on while prompt storage is off.
entry.after:
Prompt storage: Off by default for new organizations. Stores prompts and model responses for product improvements. Turn it off to enable ZDR, which also turns off passthrough models.
Passthrough models: Allows models that forward prompts and responses to third-party providers. You can turn on passthrough models only while prompt storage is on.
